title: Voice pass — end-to-end read for vocab + tone
Update _quarto.yml spine + delete obsolete stage files
Chapter 11: What to Do Next — rewrite
Restructure book for Compound IP alignment
description:
## Goal

Restructure *Co-Intelligent Co-Operation* (this book) to align with the current Compound IP as captured in the Compound Owned Vocabulary KB article ([69f352b18b15bee27](https://hq.compoundorg.com/#KnowledgeBaseArticle/view/69f352b18b15bee27)) and the Operator's Brief v1 (May 2026). Ship a v2 of the book that reads as a coherent companion to the Operator's Brief.

## Locked decisions (2026-05-11)

1. **Retire the 4-stage maturity model** (Explore → Organize → Integrate → Compound). The new spine is the 6-step Compound Sequence (Signal → Source → Design → Build → Deliver → Compound), grouped as Diagnose | Execute & Compound.
2. **Keep "Sprint"** as the unit of work — one pass through the Sequence on one validated constraint, ~6–8 weeks. Define it cleanly in the new Chapter 3.
3. **Embed stories in chapters** rather than collecting them in a separate case-study chapter.

## New chapter spine

| # | Chapter | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Preface | Keep, light edit |
| 1 | The Diagnosis | Rewrite of old Chapter 1 |
| 2 | The Co-Operating Model | NEW |
| 3 | The Framework | NEW |
| 4 | Signal | Rewrite (from old Stage 1 + Sprint Phase 1) |
| 5 | Source | Rewrite (from old Sprint Phase 2 + parts of Stage 2) |
| 6 | Design | Rewrite (combines Sprint Phase 3 + Stage 2 + Stage 3) |
| 7 | Build | Rewrite (from old Sprint Phase 4) |
| 8 | Deliver | Rewrite (from old Sprint Phase 5) |
| 9 | Compound | Rewrite (from old Sprint Phase 6) |
| 10 | The Rhythm | NEW (replaces old Stage 4) |
| 11 | What to Do Next | Rewrite — Clarity Call replaces AI Maturity Diagnostic |
| A | Appendix: Prompt Engineering | Keep, light voice edits |

## Major content additions

- The Human / Agent two-column split (brief page 3) — Chapter 2.
- Co-Intelligence + Rhythm = Compound (the Equation) — Chapter 2 / 3.
- Framework / Sequence / Rhythm / Sprint definitions — Chapter 3.
- The Compound Bench (six AI coaching agents Compound provides) — Chapter 3, then surfaced per-stage in chapters 4–9.
- The Skills Library / twelve instruments — current names, replacing stale names from old book — distributed across chapters 4–9.
- Hybrid Org Today — Chapter 10.
- The Clarity Call as the only end-of-book CTA — Chapter 11.

## Vocabulary changes (sweep)

- Orchestrated Organization → Co-Intelligent Company
- AI Maturity Diagnostic → Clarity Call
- "Organizational design" in headlines/masthead → drop (tactical-only in body)
- Twelve instruments — rename to current canonical names (Issue Surfacer, Knowledge Map, Work Deconstruction, Build Spec Writer, Guardrails Checklist, Deploy Readiness Audit, Training Set Generator, Sprint Retrospective, Constraint Re-rank)
- Sweep for forbidden words: *transform*, *leverage*, *synergy*, *AI-powered*, *augmentation*, *hybrid* alone

## Stories embedded

- Compound's three internal sprints (Knowledge Capture → Source; Process Automation → Deliver; Performance Gap → Rhythm)
- Saint Clair Systems / Scott / Rob / Brendan → Signal
- Jill's 3-hour root-cause session → Signal sidebar
- Donna + TML decomposition → Design
- Mobile home distributor → Rhythm (optional illustration)

## Workflow

Phase 1: Parallel chapter-writing agents (one per chapter). Each reads the shared writer's brief at `.claude/agents/book-rewrite-brief.md` plus its chapter-specific directives.

Phase 2: Coordinator updates `_quarto.yml` chapter spine and deletes obsolete stage-named files.

Phase 3: Voice pass agent — end-to-end read for tone consistency, forbidden words, vocab adherence.

Phase 4: Editing pass agent — coherence, cross-references, transitions, no duplication.

## Out of scope (for now)

- Excalidraw diagrams — to be added in a follow-up after the prose lands.
- New PDF cover variants (current cover is fine for v2).
- Audio / interactive versions.
- Additional stories beyond the ones already in scope.

## References

- Compound Owned Vocabulary: KnowledgeBaseArticle 69f352b18b15bee27 (canonical)
- The Operator's Brief v1: `~/Downloads/Compound — The Operator's Brief (v1).pdf` (canonical sales artifact)
- Writer's brief for agents: `.claude/agents/book-rewrite-brief.md` (in repo)

title: Deploy multiple books at books.compoundorg.com
description:
## Goal

Deploy multiple Quarto books at `books.compoundorg.com/{book-slug}/` from a single Cloudflare Pages project. Marketing-clean subpath URLs, one site feel, shared landing page listing all books.

## Current state (2026-05-11)

- Only one book exists: this repo (`compound-book`), titled "Co-Intelligent Co-Operation".
- For now, this single book will deploy directly to `books.compoundorg.com` (no subpath).
- Brand wiring is complete in this repo (HTML SCSS theme, EPUB CSS, PDF preamble + Archivo/Bricolage/JetBrains fonts installed system-wide). Outputs build cleanly to `_book/`.
- Main site `compoundorg.com` (sibling `~/compound/sites/compound/`) is a Next.js app deployed via Cloudflare Pages (`wrangler pages deploy`, `@cloudflare/next-on-pages`). Same hosting platform applies here.

## Trigger to revisit

When book #2 enters the pipeline. Earlier if marketing wants a shared `books.compoundorg.com/` landing page before then.

## Recommended architecture: umbrella monorepo

New repo `compound-books` (sibling to `compound`, `compound-book`, `compound-brochure`):

```
compound-books/
  books/
    cointelligent-cooperation/   <- this whole project moves here as-is
    (future-book)/               <- each book stays its own Quarto project
  public/
    index.html                   <- landing page listing books
  build.sh                       <- renders each book, assembles dist/
  wrangler.toml                  <- Cloudflare Pages config
```

`build.sh` loops over `books/*`, runs `quarto render` in each, copies their `_book/` to `dist/{slug}/`, then copies `public/` over the top. Cloudflare Pages serves `dist/`.

## Build environment: direct-upload (recommended for now)

Cloudflare Pages CI doesn't ship Quarto, TeX Live, or the brand fonts. Two options:

1. **Direct-upload (recommended)**: render locally with `bash build.sh`, then `wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=compound-books`. Builds use developer laptop (which already has Quarto + xelatex + brand fonts). Pages just serves what's uploaded. Predictable, no CI font-drift risk.
2. **CI build**: GitHub Actions installs Quarto + TinyTeX + Google Fonts on every push. More moving parts; CI font versions can silently drift from local. Defer until publishing cadence demands it.

## Migration steps (when triggered)

1. Create `compound-books` repo (new local + GitHub remote).
2. Move `compound-book/` contents under `books/cointelligent-cooperation/` (the slug = book directory name = URL path segment).
3. Write `build.sh` and minimal `public/index.html` (list of books, brand-styled with `compound-design-system` tokens).
4. Update each book's `_quarto.yml`: `site-url: https://books.compoundorg.com/{slug}` so internal links resolve correctly under the subpath.
5. Create a Cloudflare Pages project (direct-upload mode); point `books.compoundorg.com` at it via DNS + custom domain.
6. First deploy: `bash build.sh && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=compound-books`.

## Alternatives considered (and why not)

- **Per-book Pages projects + Cloudflare Worker for path routing**: each book is its own Pages project; a worker on `books.compoundorg.com` rewrites `/cointelligent-cooperation/*` to the right `*.pages.dev`. Works, but adds a new Pages project + DNS entry + worker per book — and the worker is load-bearing for the URL contract.
- **Per-book Pages projects + redirects only**: each book on its own `*.pages.dev`, marketing URLs do 302s. Lightest setup but breaks the "feels like one site" read.
- **Single project with Quarto book that contains all books**: one giant Quarto config with all chapters. Loses per-book versioning, makes title pages awkward, mixes table-of-contents. Don't.

## Open questions for later

- Does each book need its own RSS feed / sitemap, or one umbrella?
- Where do per-book downloads (PDF, EPUB) live in the URL space? Convention: `books.compoundorg.com/{slug}/{slug}.pdf`.
- Per-book OG images for social shares — likely each book's cover, wired in the book's own `_quarto.yml`.
- Search across books — Quarto's per-project search won't cross book boundaries. Acceptable for v1.
